A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same NicheFlow study, with readable main text and complete Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment throughout.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D report original quantitative evaluations and biological trajectory analyses on mouse embryonic development, axolotl brain development, and mouse brain aging.

after.justification: The same original experimental results are retained in Section 5 and Appendix D, including benchmark scores, ablations, and generated biological trajectories.

M1.justification: The niche construction, entropic OT coupling, mixed Gaussian/Laplace VFM objective, transformer architecture, and generation procedures remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three biological datasets and anatomical trajectory scenarios, including the appendix analyses of hemisphere formation, cavity formation, and multistep development.

E2.justification: SPFlow, RPCFlow, and LUNA retain their participation in Table 1, and moscot remains the biological trajectory comparator. Comparator membership in the appendix experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices D and F retain the same preprocessing, sampling, training settings, evaluation microenvironments, and metrics. No existing protocol is revised or new protocol introduced.

E4.justification: The objective ablations, moscot alpha sweep, OT-weight and spatial-region sweeps, conditional-generation analyses, anatomical case studies, and structural evaluations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same mean and standard-deviation reporting, five evaluation/generation runs for the relevant tables, and repeated-sampling descriptions. No uncertainty estimation or seed information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 and the qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains NicheFlow GLVFM 1NN-F1 scores of 0.664, 0.628, and 0.285 for MED, ABD, and MBA, respectively, with identical uncertainty values.

T1.justification: Equation (7) changes u_t(x) to u_t(x | x0), making explicit the conditioning already specified in Equation (5) and Appendix C.3. This is a notation correction; the assumptions, mathematical reasoning, Proposition 1, and proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about niche-level trajectory modeling, joint coordinate and expression generation, and biological and spatial reconstruction.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability boundaries are unchanged. Appendix B retains the limitations concerning fixed OT weighting, radius-based niches, slide alignment, unmodeled division/death, and in-distribution evaluation.

D1.justification: Appendices E–F retain the same pseudocode, architecture details, hyperparameters, preprocessing, optimizer, hardware, and training-time information. The project-page link and anticipated open-source release statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the 50 references are unchanged, including the positioning relative to flow matching, spatial generative models, and single-cell trajectory inference.

P1.justification: The revision makes a localized notation correction in Equation (7) and updates the first-page arXiv version/date stamp. The prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: On page 20, the discussion beneath Figure 6 moves upward, reducing the large gap after its caption. Figures, tables, captions, and their substantive displays are otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: Making source conditioning explicit in Equation (7) improves consistency with Equation (5) and Appendix C.3, while reduced spacing below Figure 6 modestly improves presentation. These are limited clarity improvements; the scientific evidence, claims, and limitations are unchanged.
